name: AfterShip
description: AfterShip tracking updates become events on the shipment's customer: Shipment In Transit, Out For Delivery, Delivered and Shipment Exception, once per shipment and status, with the courier, tracking link and expected delivery date. Customers are held back from marketing: a shipment isn't consent.

signature_secret.label: AfterShip webhook secret
signature_secret.help: AfterShip → Tracking → Settings → Webhooks → Webhook secret.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.
In AfterShip, go to Tracking → Settings → Webhooks, add the webhook URL, and tick the In transit, Out for delivery, Delivered, Exception and Failed attempt updates. Save.
Copy the webhook secret shown on the same page and save it as the integration's signing secret.
Add a shipment with a customer email (or use AfterShip's test webhook) and check the delivery log.
Review the draft out-for-delivery flow and turn it on. It's a service message about the customer's own order, so it reaches people held back from marketing.

flows.name: AfterShip: out for delivery
flows.description: When a shipment is out for delivery, tells the customer it arrives today, with the tracking link. A service message about their own order.

blocks.text: It's on the way to you

blocks.html: Hi {{ first_name|default('there') }}, your package is out for delivery today.
